patch_description: Replace the single fixed recency-weighted endpoint regression with a confidence-adaptive blend of three causal, endpoint-aligned regressions. The gentler profile is favored when the local slope is weak relative to robust volatility, reducing measurement jitter and false reversals. The more recent profile is admitted only when all regression scales agree on a strong directional slope, reducing lag during genuine persistent trends without allowing a noisy short-scale fit to dominate. All fits are precomputed once per invocation and remain vectorized, so the real-time tracker loop and computational latency are preserved.
